scripts.module-root: if [ -n "$DRUPAL_PROJECT_FOLDER" ]; then [ -d "$DRUPAL_PROJECT_FOLDER" ] && [ -f "$DRUPAL_PROJECT_FOLDER/composer.json" ] && grep -q "drupal-module" "$DRUPAL_PROJECT_FOLDER/composer.json" && echo "$DRUPAL_PROJECT_FOLDER"; elif [ -f "composer.json" ] && grep -q "drupal-module" "composer.json"; then pwd; else echo "Error: Could not determine module root." >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.composer-root: if [ -n "$DDEV_COMPOSER_ROOT" ] && [ -d "$DDEV_COMPOSER_ROOT" ]; then echo "$DDEV_COMPOSER_ROOT"; exit 0; fi; d=.; i=0; while [ $i -lt 10 ]; do if [ -f "$d/composer.json" ] && grep -q '"type"' "$d/composer.json" && grep -q '"project"' "$d/composer.json"; then readlink -f "$d"; break; fi; d="../$d"; i=$((i+1)); done
scripts.install-dev-deps: PACKAGES=$(cat composer.json | jq -r '.["require-dev"] // {} | to_entries[] | "\(.key):\(.value)"' | tr '\n' ' ') && ROOT=$(composer run composer-root) && CORE_VERSION=$(grep "const VERSION" "${ROOT}/core/lib/Drupal.php" 2>/dev/null | sed "s/.*'\(.*\)'.*/\1/" || echo "0.0.0") && COMPOSER_ROOT_VERSION=${CORE_VERSION:-0.0.0} composer --working-dir=${ROOT} require ${PACKAGES} --dev -W
scripts.phpcs: MODULE_DIR=$(composer run module-root) && COMPOSER_ROOT=$(composer run composer-root) && (cd "$MODULE_DIR" && mkdir -p test-results && mkdir -p .cache/phpcs && "$COMPOSER_ROOT/vendor/bin/phpcs" --standard=./phpcs.xml --report-width=auto --colors -s --report-junit=./test-results/phpcs.xml --report-full --report-summary "$MODULE_DIR")
scripts.phpcbf: MODULE_DIR=$(composer run module-root) && COMPOSER_ROOT=$(composer run composer-root) && (cd "$MODULE_DIR" && mkdir -p .cache/phpcs && "$COMPOSER_ROOT/vendor/bin/phpcbf" --standard=./phpcs.xml --colors "$MODULE_DIR" || [ $? -eq 1 ])
scripts.phpstan: MODULE_DIR=$(composer run module-root) && COMPOSER_ROOT=$(composer run composer-root) && (cd "$MODULE_DIR" && "$COMPOSER_ROOT/vendor/bin/phpstan" --configuration=./phpstan.neon --autoload-file="$MODULE_DIR/phpstan_rules/autoload.php" analyze "$MODULE_DIR")
scripts.phpstan-regenerate-ignores-for-11.3-and-: MODULE_DIR=$(composer run module-root) && COMPOSER_ROOT=$(composer run composer-root) && (cd "$MODULE_DIR" && rm -f ./phpstan-11.3-and-higher-ignores.neon && touch ./phpstan-11.3-and-higher-ignores.neon && "$COMPOSER_ROOT/vendor/bin/phpstan" --configuration=./phpstan.neon --autoload-file="$MODULE_DIR/phpstan_rules/autoload.php" --generate-baseline=./phpstan-11.3-and-higher-ignores.neon analyze "$MODULE_DIR")
scripts.ui-build: ROOT=$(composer run composer-root) && drush --root=$ROOT pm:uninstall canvas_vite -y > /dev/null 2>&1 || true && npm run build -w ui
scripts.ui-dev: ROOT=$(composer run composer-root) && drush --root=$ROOT pm:install canvas_vite -y > /dev/null 2>&1 || true && npm run drupaldev -w ui -- --host

scripts-descriptions.install-dev-deps: Installs Canvas' dev dependencies into host Drupal project.
scripts-descriptions.lint:phpcs: Runs PHPCS using Canvas' rules, generates CI artifact.
scripts-descriptions.lint:phpstan: Runs PHPStan using Canvas' rules, generates CI artifact.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan-regenerate-ignores-for-non-min-c: Regenerates PHPStan baseline for Canvas-provided features that require a core version beyond the minimum supported version.
scripts-descriptions.phpunit: Runs Canvas' back-end test suite. Supports running subset, use `composer run phpunit -- --help`.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Runs all Canvas back-end (PHP) linting. Sibling: `npm run lint`.
scripts-descriptions.fix: Runs all Canvas back-end (PHP) auto-fixing. Sibling: `npm run fix`.
